card.name: Incoming and outgoing flow words
card.fires_on: Direction words such as outgoing, incoming, inbound and exit that describe things flowing in or out, such as light rays, energy or links. Mostly in physics and web-science text, with a few partial words like Out-comes and eff-luent.
